attributes.name: card_content_richness
attributes.definition: Which metadata/media elements content cards include beyond a title.

values.definition: Cards contain only a title and a summary/teaser, with no image, date or byline.
Cards contain a date and headline, with no image or summary/byline.
Cards include thumbnails or images, possibly with dates or bylines.
Other combination or no cards present.

attributes.name: card_thumbnail_presence
attributes.definition: Whether content cards display a thumbnail or image.

values.definition: Cards are text-only with no thumbnail images.

attributes.name: card_grid_columns
attributes.definition: Number of columns in the row or grid of cards.

values.definition: Cards are arranged in three columns.

attributes.name: card_semantic_markup
attributes.definition: Whether post cards use semantic HTML elements such as article, aside or figure.

values.definition: Cards and sections use generic elements without article, aside or figure.
Cards use article, figure or similar semantic elements.
